issues.message: /wɪnd/ 与 kind 的元音不同；发音总表把所有动词统一标成 /waɪnd/，与“使气喘”的 /wɪnd/ 用法冲突。学习计划中禁止使用 winded 的说法也过于绝对。
天气义 wind 兼有不可数和可数用法，不能概括为“通常作可数名词”；the 本身也不能用来判断可数性。
及物“缠绕”和不及物“蜿蜒延伸”被合并，各只有一个例句，搭配与近反义说明也混在一起。应分开教学，每义保留至少两个例句。
遗漏常用名词义“气息”、get wind of“听到风声”、英式英语中常见的“肠胃胀气”，以及 wind up 的常见功能。
缠绕义首先应对照 unwind；unwrap 只适用于拆开包裹等特定场景，不能代替直接相关的反向动词。
只含名词 wound“伤口”的例句错误绑定到 wind 的缠绕义。可改成同时出现 wound /waʊnd/ 和 wound /wuːnd/ 的句子，使绑定成立。
已取得的词源材料还列出古英语 windan，以及吹奏义动词与古英语 wind 的关系，初稿未完整利用。两条来源应并列说明，不能画成连续历史阶段。
Oxford 未提供实际来源内容，Cambridge 抓取失败，不能让正文引用它们来承担已核实依据。应保留实际取得的维基词典英语词条，并把其支持范围写准确；专业语言知识补充项不虚挂来源。

review.coverageAssessment: 已清点原释义表与实际取得的英语词条，核对天气、气息、缠绕、卷绕、上发条、蜿蜒、使气喘、风声、趋势、空谈、嗅闻和吹奏等义项。补丁将缠绕与蜿蜒拆开，补齐常用名词义及 wind up 的常见功能，各核心义均有两个原创英中例句。低频的嗅闻、吹奏、绞起等另作简要提示；原释义表中旧式“使通风”和独立名词“气味、卷绕、弯曲”不扩展为初中核心义。本审校不声称穷尽所有历史、方言或专业用法。

{"id":"wind-v-route","title":"蜿蜒延伸","meaning":"道路、河流、小路等弯弯曲曲地延伸。","usageNote":"读 /waɪnd/，此处作不及物动词，主语常是 road、path、river。through、along、around 等介词引出路线；不是简单地在路口转一次弯。","examples":[{"id":"wind-v-route-ex1","senseId":"wind-v-route","en":"A narrow path winds through the forest.","zh":"一条窄路蜿蜒穿过森林。","note":"path 作主语，winds 后不接直接宾语。"},{"id":"wind-v-route-ex2","senseId":"wind-v-route","en":"The road wound up the hillside to a small village.","zh":"这条路沿山坡蜿蜒向上，通往一个小村庄。","note":"wound 是过去式；这里 up 表示沿山坡向上，不是上发条。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"a road / path / river winds through / along / around somewhere","zh":"道路／小路／河流蜿蜒穿过／沿着／绕着某处延伸","note":"用介词短语说明延伸的路线。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"a winding road","zh":"蜿蜒的道路","note":"winding /ˈwaɪndɪŋ/ 在这里作形容词。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"meander","zh":"蜿蜒；曲折前行","note":"也可描述河流、道路，常突出曲折且不直接的路线。"},{"en":"snake","zh":"蛇行；曲折延伸","note":"形象地突出像蛇一样弯曲，可描述道路或队伍。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"run straight","zh":"笔直延伸","note":"主语同样可以是道路、河流等，与弯曲延伸形成语境对照。"}],"similarNote":"三者都能描述曲折路线；wind 是常用的路线描述，snake 更具形象性。","contrastingNote":"可用 The road runs straight 描述相反的路线形状；straighten a road 则表示把道路改直，是另一种及物结构。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-n-breath","title":"气息；呼吸能力","meaning":"能使人正常呼吸、继续活动的气息，常见于失去气息或恢复呼吸的表达。","usageNote":"读 /wɪnd/，此义通常不可数。常说 knock the wind out of someone、get one's wind back；一般说一次呼吸或深呼吸时用 breath，不用 a wind。","examples":[{"id":"wind-n-breath-ex1","senseId":"wind-n-breath","en":"The fall knocked the wind out of me.","zh":"这一跤摔得我一时喘不过气。","note":"knock the wind out of someone 表示使某人暂时喘不过气。"},{"id":"wind-n-breath-ex2","senseId":"wind-n-breath","en":"I stopped halfway up the stairs to get my wind back.","zh":"楼梯爬到一半时，我停下来缓了缓气。","note":"get my wind back 表示恢复正常呼吸。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"knock the wind out of someone","zh":"使某人一时喘不过气","note":"常用于摔倒或身体受到撞击。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"get one's wind back","zh":"缓过气来","note":"恢复气息，也常说 get one's breath back。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"breath","zh":"气息；呼吸","note":"一般呼吸表达中适用范围更广，如 take a deep breath。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"be out of breath","zh":"上气不接下气","note":"与 get one's wind back 所表示的恢复状态相对照，不是名词 wind 的通用反义词。"}],"similarNote":"在恢复气息的表达中 wind 与 breath 接近；不能把 take a breath 改成 take a wind。","contrastingNote":"喘不过气与缓过气是语境中的相反状态。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-n-news","title":"听到风声中的“风声”","meaning":"某件事的消息或传闻，尤其是尚未正式公开的事。","usageNote":"读 /wɪnd/，主要在 get wind of、catch wind of 中学习，of 后接消息涉及的事情。不能把 wind 当作 news 的通用替换词。","examples":[{"id":"wind-n-news-ex1","senseId":"wind-n-news","en":"We got wind of the shop's closing sale and went there after school.","zh":"我们听说那家店要清仓停业，放学后就去了。","note":"get wind of 表示听到某事的消息。"},{"id":"wind-n-news-ex2","senseId":"wind-n-news","en":"If Leo catches wind of the surprise party, it won't be a surprise anymore.","zh":"如果利奥听到了惊喜派对的风声，那就不再是惊喜了。","note":"if 从句用一般现在时，主句用将来表达。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"get / catch wind of something","zh":"听到某事的风声","note":"of 是固定搭配中的介词，后接名词或名词短语。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"collocations":[{"en":"get wind of a plan","zh":"听到某项计划的风声","note":"常指计划还未正式公开时听到了消息。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"hear about","zh":"听说","note":"适用范围较广，不一定是未公开的消息。"},{"en":"hear a rumor about","zh":"听到关于……的传闻","note":"明确把消息称为传闻；get wind of 本身不表示消息一定不实。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"remain unaware of","zh":"仍不知道","note":"描述尚未获知消息的状态。"}],"similarNote":"get wind of 常带听到内部消息或隐约风声的意味；hear about 更中性。","contrastingNote":"remain unaware of 表示未获知，与听到风声后的知情状态对照。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-n-gas","title":"肠胃中的气体；胀气","meaning":"胃或肠道里的气体，可能使人感到胀气或需要打嗝、排气。","usageNote":"读 /wɪnd/，不可数，主要是英式用法；美式英语通常用 gas。此义不表示空气中的风。","examples":[{"id":"wind-n-gas-ex1","senseId":"wind-n-gas","en":"The baby had wind after her feed.","zh":"宝宝喝完奶后肚子里有气。","note":"英式表达，指喂奶后肠胃里有气体。"},{"id":"wind-n-gas-ex2","senseId":"wind-n-gas","en":"Beans sometimes give me wind.","zh":"吃豆子有时会让我胀气。","note":"give someone wind 表示使某人肠胃胀气。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"give someone wind","zh":"使某人胀气","note":"wind 不加 a，也不变成复数。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"trapped wind","zh":"积在肠胃里排不出的气体","note":"常用于描述胀气的不适。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"gas","zh":"肠胃中的气体","note":"该义在美式英语中常用；gas 也有其他含义。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"此义的英式 wind 与美式 gas 接近；bloating 描述腹胀，不等同于气体本身。","contrastingNote":"气体这种具体事物没有需要记忆的直接反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-up-finish","title":"wind up：结束、完成","meaning":"使会议、谈话或一项活动结束。","usageNote":"读 /waɪnd ʌp/，过去式为 wound up /waʊnd ʌp/。可说 wind up a meeting 或 wind a meeting up；代词必须放中间：wind it up。","examples":[{"id":"wind-up-finish-ex1","senseId":"wind-up-finish","en":"Let's wind up the meeting before lunch.","zh":"我们午饭前结束会议吧。","note":"wind up 后接要结束的活动。"},{"id":"wind-up-finish-ex2","senseId":"wind-up-finish","en":"The club members wound the discussion up at six.","zh":"俱乐部成员在六点结束了讨论。","note":"名词宾语 the discussion 放在 wound 和 up 之间。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"wind something up / wind up something","zh":"结束某事","note":"这是可分的短语动词；代词宾语必须放中间。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"wind up a meeting / discussion","zh":"结束会议／讨论","note":"不表示给会议或讨论上发条。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"wrap up","zh":"结束；完成","note":"在结束会议、讨论或工作时与 wind up 接近。"},{"en":"finish","zh":"结束；完成","note":"范围更广，不是每个 finish 都适合换成 wind up。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"start","zh":"开始","note":"可用于同一项会议、讨论或活动的起点。"},{"en":"continue","zh":"继续","note":"与此刻结束活动形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"wind up 和 wrap up 常用于把正在进行的活动收尾。","contrastingNote":"start 对照开始与结束，continue 对照继续与停止。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-up-result","title":"wind up：最后处于；结果做了","meaning":"经过一连串事情后，最终处于某处、某种状态，或做了某事。","usageNote":"非正式用法，读 /waɪnd ʌp/。常接 doing 或地点介词短语；这里的 up 后面不接表示目的的不定式。结果常出人意料，但不一定是坏结果。","examples":[{"id":"wind-up-result-ex1","senseId":"wind-up-result","en":"We missed the last bus and wound up walking home.","zh":"我们错过了末班车，最后只好走路回家。","note":"wind up doing 表示最终做了某事。"},{"id":"wind-up-result-ex2","senseId":"wind-up-result","en":"We took a wrong turn and wound up at the station.","zh":"我们拐错了弯，结果到了车站。","note":"wind up at 后接最终到达的地点。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"wind up doing something","zh":"最后做了某事","note":"这里接 -ing 形式，如 wound up waiting。","kind":"sentence-pattern"},{"en":"wind up in / at somewhere","zh":"最后到了某处","note":"介词根据地点选择，如 in a village、at the station。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"wind up in trouble","zh":"最终惹上麻烦","note":"这是常见搭配，但 wind up 本身不限定结果好坏。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"end up","zh":"最后处于；结果做了","note":"在这类结果句中通常非常接近，也可接 doing 或地点短语。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"可将两个例句中的 wound up 换成 ended up，保留主要意思。","contrastingNote":"表示最终结果的用法没有一个适用于所有语境的直接反义词；start 不是它的通用反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-up-annoy","title":"wind someone up：逗弄、惹恼某人","meaning":"故意说话或做事来逗弄某人，或使某人生气、紧张。","usageNote":"主要用于英式非正式英语，读 /waɪnd ʌp/。宾语是人；人称代词放在 wind 与 up 之间，如 wind me up。具体是玩笑还是惹恼，要看上下文。","examples":[{"id":"wind-up-annoy-ex1","senseId":"wind-up-annoy","en":"Don't believe Ben—he's just winding you up.","zh":"别信本的话，他只是在逗你。","note":"这里指开玩笑地逗弄，不一定真的使人生气。"},{"id":"wind-up-annoy-ex2","senseId":"wind-up-annoy","en":"My brother keeps hiding my phone to wind me up.","zh":"我弟弟老把我的手机藏起来，故意惹我生气。","note":"这里突出故意惹恼；to wind me up 表示藏手机的目的。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"wind someone up","zh":"逗弄／惹恼某人","note":"代词必须放中间：wind him up，不说 wind up him。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"just winding you up","zh":"只是在逗你","note":"常用来说明先前的话是玩笑。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"tease","zh":"逗弄；取笑","note":"与玩笑性逗弄接近，但 tease 也可带伤人的意味。"},{"en":"annoy","zh":"惹恼","note":"不一定出于故意，也不一定通过玩笑。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"calm someone down","zh":"使某人平静下来","note":"与使人激动、生气的用法相对，不是开玩笑义的通用反义表达。"}],"similarNote":"玩笑语境可接近 tease；惹人生气的语境可接近 annoy。","contrastingNote":"calm someone down 只与情绪被激起的用法形成对照。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-n-trend","title":"风向；变化趋势（比喻）","meaning":"像风向一样影响局势的力量或变化趋势。","note":"读 /wɪnd/，常见于 winds of change；不能在所有表示 trend 的地方直接换成 wind。","example":{"id":"wind-n-trend-ex1","senseId":"wind-n-trend","en":"The winds of change were blowing through the company.","zh":"变革之风正吹遍这家公司。","note":"winds of change 是比喻表达，不是实际天气。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-n-empty-talk","title":"空话；夸夸其谈","meaning":"没有多少实际内容或行动支持的话。","note":"读 /wɪnd/，不可数，带贬义；日常也常用 hot air 表达类似意思。","example":{"id":"wind-n-empty-talk-ex1","senseId":"wind-n-empty-talk","en":"His promises were all wind; he never helped us.","zh":"他的承诺全是空话；他从来没帮过我们。","note":"这是带批评意味的表达，不是一般中性的谈话。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-v-scent","title":"嗅到气味、嗅出猎物","meaning":"凭气味察觉人或动物，尤其用于狩猎语境。","note":"读 /wɪnd/，过去式和过去分词为 winded；这是低频用法，日常通常用 smell 或 pick up the scent of。","example":{"id":"wind-v-scent-ex1","senseId":"wind-v-scent","en":"The hound winded the fox and followed its trail.","zh":"猎犬嗅到了狐狸的气味，循迹追去。","note":"hound 是猎犬；winded 在这里表示嗅到，不是气喘。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"wind-v-horn","title":"吹奏管乐器、吹响号角（旧式）","meaning":"向管乐器中吹气，使它发声。","note":"这里读 /wɪnd/，规则过去式为 winded。这是旧式、文学性用法；现代日常英语通常说 blow a horn 或 play a wind instrument。","example":{"id":"wind-v-horn-ex1","senseId":"wind-v-horn","en":"The hunter winded his horn to call the others.","zh":"猎人吹响号角，召唤其他人。","note":"旧式叙事用法；to call the others 表示吹号的目的。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-etymology"]}

{"id":"wind-v-hoist","title":"用卷绕装置绞起、吊起","meaning":"通过卷绕绳索或缆绳把某物提升上来。","note":"读 /waɪnd/，过去式为 wound；强调卷绕装置的作用，不是所有“抬起”都能用 wind。","example":{"id":"wind-v-hoist-ex1","senseId":"wind-v-hoist","en":"They turned the handle and wound the bucket up out of the well.","zh":"他们转动把手，把水桶从井里绞了上来。","note":"wound the bucket up 表示通过卷绕绳索把桶提升上来。"},"sourceIds":[]}

patches.valueJson: "名词 wind“风”和读 /wɪnd/、表示吹奏管乐器的动词 wind，来自古英语 wind；读 /waɪnd/、表示缠绕或上发条的动词 wind，来自古英语 windan。这是两条并列的古英语来源，不是先有“风”、再由它发展出“缠绕”的一条历史链。"
